hero.lede: A group agrees on an amount and a rhythm. Everyone pays in each round; one member takes the whole pot. Everyone gets exactly one turn - and a deposit covers anyone who misses, so whoever’s turn it is gets paid in full.

browse.title: Open circles
browse.empty_desc: Starting one takes a single transaction, and the terms are fixed the moment it exists.

create.title: Start a circle
create.sub: You set the terms. They are fixed once it exists, and anyone can read them before putting in a unit.
create.deal_desc: {capacity} members put in {amount} every {duration}. Each round one of them takes the pot. Joining locks {deposit} as a deposit, returned when the circle completes.
create.err_contribution: Enter a contribution greater than zero.
create.err_members: A circle needs between 3 and 24 members.
create.deal_part4: Each round one of them takes the pot. Joining locks
create.deal_part5: as a deposit, returned when the circle completes.

circle.headline_complete: Every turn has been taken. Deposits are free to withdraw.
circle.nothing_to_do: Nothing for you to do right now.
circle.btn_connect: Connect a wallet to take part
circle.note_forming: You are in at seat {seat} - that is the round you get paid.
circle.note_active_not_in: This circle is running and closed to new members.
circle.note_active_paid: You are paid up for round {round}. Waiting on the others - {remaining}.
circle.note_complete_exhausted: Nothing left to withdraw - your deposit covered a round you missed.
circle.rotation_sub: Payout order is join order, fixed the moment the circle filled.

footer.desc: Reads are simulated against a public RPC node - no wallet, no account, no fee. Writes are transactions your own wallet signs. No server and no custody anywhere: the {contractLink} holds the funds and the rules, and anyone may settle a round.
